description.en: What must not change when a region is edited
How the full image is shot

text: Shoot it as a professional architectural interior photograph: full-frame camera, 24–35 mm rectilinear lens at eye level about 1.5 m, f/8 with everything in focus, vertical lines kept perfectly vertical, no fisheye.

description.vi: Hậu kỳ và độ thật (ảnh đầy đủ)
description.en: Finish and realism of the full image

text: Natural color, realistic dynamic range (no HDR look), very fine natural sensor grain, accurate white balance; the room looks clean and newly installed, with no people, text or clutter. It must be indistinguishable from a real photograph, not a 3D render.
